method.selection: Complete the existing greedy RMS cut selection before filtering; retain an ordered subsequence with identical cut times.
method.veto: At each saved cut center, compare the one-period RMS low-region width against the existing 15 ms limit using the same side-specific 0.7 crest thresholds. Keep cuts when fine geometry is invalid; veto valid broad valleys.

protocol.acceptance: All twelve note/offset pooled F and twelve true-positive comparisons must be nondecreasing across six observed reference groups.

diagnosis.effect: The merged parent matches an earlier note, losing the later true note against both annotators. The fixed gain control loses the same true note.
diagnosis.other_changes: Four false positives are removed in vocadito_2 against each annotator; one false positive is removed in f2_scales_breathy_a against both conventions. These gains do not satisfy the fixed recall and offset conditions.

confirmation.reason: Observed-data acceptance failed before the confirmation phase.

performance.reason: Observed-data acceptance failed before the cost phase.

reproduction.matching: Maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching; onset tolerance 50 ms, pitch tolerance 50 cents, and offset tolerance max(50 ms, 20% of reference duration).

limitations: All recordings scored here are observed development data; this experiment supplies no new held-out confirmation.
Passing the generated AM matrix does not establish that real articulation is preserved.
Known low-register missed repeats and wide-vibrato extra boundaries remain baseline limitations.
No recording-specific exceptions or post-result threshold adjustments were applied.
